description:
Kakao's transparency-report statistics API, reverse-engineered from the
public Kakao Privacy site (privacy.kakao.com/transparency). Kakao publishes
semiannual statistics on South Korean government requests for user data —
communication user information, communication-restricting measures,
communication confirmation data (log records), and search & seizure
warrants — split by service corporation (Kakao vs. Daum), from the first
half of 2012 to the latest published half-year.

The site's page JS (`/js/renew/sub/transparency.js`) drives a single
unauthenticated JSON endpoint: `GET /api/transparency/{year}/{halfYearId}`.
Each response carries the half-year's eight statistics rows (2 service
corporations x 4 request categories), a narrative summary, links to the
downloadable XLSX workbooks (Korean and English editions), and
prev/next-report availability flags for pagination across half-years.

Localization: the `Accept-Language` request header switches the localized
fields (`title`, `content`, `halfYear`, `fileUrl`, and each report row's
`category`/`content`) between Korean (`ko`) and English (`en`). The `en*`
twin fields (`enTitle`, `enContent`, `enCategory`, `enFileUrl`) always
carry the English text regardless of the negotiated language.

Coverage note: requesting a year/half-year outside the published range
(before 1H 2012 or after the latest report) returns the site's HTML error
page with HTTP 200, not a JSON error — clients should verify the response
is JSON with `success: true`. Use `prevYn`/`nextYn` (1 = exists, 0 = end
of range) to walk the archive safely.

tools.name: transparency_get-report
tools.description: Returns the transparency-report statistics for one half-year: eight statistics rows (Kakao and Daum, each across the four government request categories), the narrative summary, XLSX download links, and prev/next availability flags. Published range starts at 1H 2012. Required: year, halfYearId (default: 1).

params.name: year
params.description: Report year (2012 through the latest published year).

params.name: halfYearId
params.description: Half-year selector: 1 = first half (1H), 2 = second half (2H).
